g.aria-label: Wildlife Habitat Ecologist - Ministry of Forests
“We can’t go into the next millenium continuing
to have this many bears wandering around town.
It is only a matter of time before someone is seri-
ously hurt. We don’t want to leave it until then to
realize we should have cleaned up our problem.”
For more information contact Revelstoke’s Bear
